title: Third-Party Risk Management for AI Vendors: An Interagency TPRM Playbook for Banks
summary: How banks should run TPRM for AI vendors under the 2023 interagency guidance (SR 23-4, OCC Bulletin 2023-17, FDIC FIL-29-2023) — covering the diligence pack, contract terms, ongoing monitoring, and concentration risk.
